Featuring a complete player database with features such as…
•	The ability to search for players using their stats at max level, not just level 1.
•	Calculates the dribbling skills that each player can perform and shows controller animations on how to perform them.
•	Calculates exactly how player condition affects player stats and overall rating.
•	Player cards show the top 6 key stats of each player so you can quickly see each player’s strong points.
•	Keeps track of player condition throughout the season to help you make better decisions on who to level-up.



MANAGER DATABASE
Featuring a manager database with features such as…
•	Easily see managers that have changed formation and tactics every week.
•	Search for managers by their attacking or defensive tactics.
•	Custom formation search tool to assist you in finding the exact formation that you need.



SQUAD BUILDER
Featuring a squad builder that is designed to help you learn and understand how to build a squad with high team strength and low contract cost. Features include…
•	Team strength calculations which is ideal for building 2,3 and 4 star strength squads.
•	See how players can be positioned with different managers.
•	Save an unlimited amount of squads.
•	Auto squad build that will build a squad for you based on the parameters you choose.
•	Total squad contract cost.
 
GAME PLAN
Game Plan simulates player off the ball movement in attack and defence. This allows you to view any weak and strong points in your manager's tactics against other managers.
 
HIDDEN GEM FINDER
Easily find hidden gems with high potential and low contract renewal cost.
 
MY TEAM
Save your players and managers so that they are easily accessible for viewing or squad building.
 
DRIBBLING SKILL TUTORIALS
Tutorials with controller animations showing you exactly how to perform dribbling skill move for console and mobile.
